definitions.text: Charges assigned to atoms, arising from the uneven distribution of electrons in bonds, that are used to calculate intermolecular interaction energy or to characterize the charge distribution of a molecule.

notes.1: The charges can be derived from quantum chemical population analyses, fitted dipole moments or electrostatic potentials, spectroscopic data, or from partitioning electron density.
notes.2: There is no firm theoretical basis for the assignment of partial atomic charges, hence there is no correct one.
